en: Black-and-white postcard-style photograph of a European riverside city. In the foreground a wide river is crossed by two adjacent bridges: an older stone-arch bridge and a newer steel-girder bridge on concrete piers. A long river barge steams upstream, and densely packed houses line the opposite bank. On the hill above stands a large fortified palace complex with multiple towers and steep roofs; one tall structure is surrounded by scaffolding. A church with a pointed spire is visible nearby. The scene suggests an old town with a castle overlooking the river and bridges.
